issues: Covers rose week on week and year on year.
Spend per head dipped week on week, an expected effect of the student ramen promotion, and was flat year on year.
Sales rose week on week and year on year and finished well above target.
Ramen section speed is the main factor stopping tables turning faster; the kitchen has been asked to keep two people on ramen at peak times and prep during quieter periods.
Afternoon Lynas deliveries make it hard to complete prep before opening.
An EHO visit is expected soon as the site has not had one in two years, and the GM is working with the kitchen leads on compliance and any purchases needed to pass.
The glass washer is still leaking and is under warranty, so Kris advised contacting the manufacturer.
Five chairs are missing and China stock is out, so no replacements can be received, which reduces maximum covers and weekend sales.
Two back of house team members return next week, two more will be off for a month from next week, and one is training on ramen.
A front of house team member returns on 26/09/2026 and is away again from 01/10/2026 to 05/10/2026.
A front of house team member transfers back to the site on 02/10/2026, and another's last day is 22/09/2026.
A back of house trial runs 15:00 to 17:00 on 22/09/2026, and the site needs one more full or part time back of house hire as several staff are working six day weeks.
Pest control, fire safety, electrical, gas and ventilation compliance were all completed.
XOXO continues, app use is expected to rise after the freshers fair, and the Matcha specials have finished.
